dct_description_sm:
Boundaries delineating the neighbourhood associations within the City of Waterloo. Neighbourhood associations are groups of people who live in the same 
neighbourhood that come together to initiate and maintain a wide range 
of programs and activities. This dataset contains information indicating whether the groups is affiliated with the City of Waterloo and contains links to the websites or social media for each association. Updates to this dataset are made as required.
schema_provider_s: The Region of Waterloo - Open Data
